items.note: The answer has no document at all, only tool calls for searching the repo. Nothing says the product is a B2B note-taking app.
Nothing is written for engineering and design leads, and there's no kickoff content.
The v1 scope (creating a workspace, inviting members by email, shared notes) is never described.
Roles are never defined. The 'role' and 'permission' terms only show up as patterns in file searches.
There's no out-of-scope section. Billing, SSO and guest access are never listed as excluded. 'billing' only appears as a search term.
The success metric (20% of paid accounts create a workspace within 60 days) never appears.
The output is short, but there's no document whose length could be checked. The limit only means something once a document exists.
Migration of existing shared notes is never mentioned, so it isn't raised as an open question.
